noWebgl: 3D rendering is unavailable in this browser, so the plate cannot be shown. Your progress and settings are preserved.
practice.sub: Relaxed play. No effect on rating.
ji.j01: Tap an arrow with a clear lane to send it off the plate. Clear them all.
ji.j02: Arrows block each other. Free the blocked ones by removing what stands in their lane.
ji.j05: A larger plate — plan a few exits ahead.
ji.j08: Every exit opens a lane for someone else.
ji.j09: New: bolts. They never move and block lanes permanently.
ji.j10: MASTERY: everything so far — a crowded, bolted plate.
ji.j15: New: a time limit. Work briskly.
ji.j17: New: big arrows. They span two cells and need both lanes clear.
ji.j20: MASTERY: big arrows among the bolts.
ji.j25: The largest plate in the shop.
ji.j30: MASTERY: a clock, bolts, and big rigs at once.
ji.j40: MASTERY: the definitive plate. Good luck.
chi.c1: Clear the plate in 90 seconds. No undo.
chi.c2: No hints. Chase the flawless bonus: zero mistakes.
chi.c3: Eight bolts carve the plate into narrow lanes. No undo.
chi.c4: Four big arrows, no assists. Both lanes or nothing.
chi.c5: Sixteen arrows, two minutes. No undo.
chi.c6: Time limit, bolts, big rigs, no assists. The full test.
score.intro: Plate after plate. Play until no arrow has a clear lane.
daily.name: Daily {date}
daily.intro: One shared seed for everyone, today only.
lx.t1: This arrow faces the open edge — its lane is clear. Tap it (or move the focus ring with arrow keys and press Enter) to send it off the plate.
lx.t2: The right arrow points left, but its twin blocks the lane. Send off the clear arrow first — that opens the lane for the blocked one. Clear both.
lx.t3: Tapping a blocked arrow is a mistake: it shakes, explains itself, and costs your flawless bonus. Tap the blocked right-hand arrow once to see why it cannot leave.
lx.t4: The dark bolt is riveted to the plate: it blocks lanes forever and cannot be removed. Route around it and clear all three arrows.
lx.t5: The wide arrow spans two cells and needs BOTH lanes clear. Free the small arrow above its path first, then send the big rig off. Clear the plate.
lx.t6: In relaxed modes you can undo (U) or ask for a hint (H). Send any arrow off, then undo it to finish the lesson.
p.offline: Offline — progress is stored on this device.
